entries.title: A Hard Winter in the North
entries.about: Our own example: a Nordic winter that tests four trade and defence pacts. Play any country; the North is where the story is.

entries.title: A Hard Winter: the Thaw
entries.about: Our own example of a fork: the same North three months on, made from A Hard Winter in the North.

entries.title: Three bots on a small island
entries.about: Our own example: three bots play the traditional rules on a small round island until one of them holds it all. Step through it move by move.
